init.title: Pulse PRO options
init.description: Blinds found on the hub so far: {blinds}

data.use_websocket: Read signal strength and online status
data.restart_switch: Smart plug that powers the hub (optional)
data.restart_after: Restart the hub after no blind has reported for (minutes)

data_description.extra_blinds: 3-character IDs separated by commas, for blinds that discovery missed (e.g. asleep or out of range).
data_description.excluded_blinds: 3-character IDs separated by commas, for devices you don't want in Home Assistant.
data_description.position_interval: How often blinds that report their position are asked for it. Blinds that don't answer are only asked once an hour. Positions are also re-checked after every command.
data_description.invert_position: Turn this on if the position is the wrong way round (a fully open blind shows 0 % instead of 100 %).
data_description.battery_min_voltage: Leave both at 0 to detect 12 V or 8.4 V packs automatically. The 'Battery Voltage' diagnostic sensor shows what your blinds report.
data_description.battery_max_voltage: Must be higher than the empty voltage.
data_description.use_websocket: Reads each blind's signal strength and online status from the hub's WebSocket (port 443, the interface the Automate app uses) every 5 minutes. Turn this off if your hub doesn't offer it. Blind control doesn't depend on it.
data_description.restart_switch: If set, the hub is power cycled (off for 30 seconds) when no blind has reported for the time below, at most once every 3 hours. A Restart hub button is added as well. Choose the plug the hub is connected to, and set it to switch on by itself after a power cut.
data_description.restart_after: Only used with a smart plug. At least three position checks are always waited for. After 24 hours without any report, automatic restarts pause until a blind reports again.

error.invalid_blind_id: Blind IDs are 3 letters or numbers, separated by commas (e.g. ABC, X1Y).
error.invalid_voltage_range: Set both voltages (empty lower than full), or set both to 0 for automatic.
